metadata.question: Did Washington D.C. experience an air temperature difference of at least 24 degrees Celcius between January 29 and February 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Washington D.C. (approximately 38.9072°N, 77.0369°W) - Dates: January 29, 2019 and February 5, 2019 - Collection: ECMWF ERA5-Land or MODIS Land Surface Temperature. ERA5-Land has better air temperature data at 2m height. - Use ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated collection: 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGREGATED' - Band: 'temperature_2m' (in Kelvin, need to convert to Celsius) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for ERA5-Land (reanalysis data) - This is about actual temperature, not clouds 3. Logic to distinguish: - Get temperature for Jan 29, 2019 - Get temperature for Feb 5, 2019 - Calculate absolute difference - Valid Zero: If difference exists but is < 24°C → B - Success: If difference ≥ 24°C → A - C1: If no data available for either date - C2: If valid pixels = 0 after processing - C3: If temperature values are None/NaN or unrealistic (e.g., < -100°C or > 100°C) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Washington D.C. const dc = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.0369, 38.9072]); // 2. Define dates const date1 = '2019-01-29'; const date2 = '2019-02-05'; // 3. Get ERA5-Land daily temperature data const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGREGATED'); // Get image for January 29 const img1 = era5.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')).first(); const size1 = era5.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')).size().getInfo(); // Get image for February 5 const img2 = era5.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')).first(); const size2 = era5.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')).size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found - Jan 29: ${size1}, Feb 5: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both dates'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Extract temperature values (in Kelvin, convert to Celsius) // temperature_2m is in Kelvin, subtract 273.15 to get Celsius const temp1_dict = img1.select('temperature_2m').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: dc, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const temp2_dict = img2.select('temperature_2m').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: dc, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const temp1_k = temp1_dict.get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); const temp2_k = temp2_dict.get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); // Check for null values if (temp1_k === null || temp2_k === null) { console.log('Temperature calculation failed - null values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert to Celsius const temp1_c = temp1_k - 273.15; const temp2_c = temp2_k - 273.15; // Validate temperature range (-100 to 100°C is reasonable) if (temp1_c < -100 || temp1_c > 100 || temp2_c < -100 || temp2_c > 100) { console.log(`Invalid temperature values: ${temp1_c.toFixed(2)}°C, ${temp2_c.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log('C3'); return; } // Calculate absolute difference const temp_diff = Math.abs(temp1_c - temp2_c); // 5. Print results and determine answer console.log(`Jan 29, 2019: ${temp1_c.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Feb 5, 2019: ${temp2_c.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Temperature difference: ${temp_diff.toFixed(2)}°C`); if (temp_diff >= 24) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
